gaps.detail: The runtime-safe GitWorkspaceAgentRegistryStore writes canonical atomic JSON but intentionally does not own Git credentials, commit signing, protected-branch review, or remote push. Production deployment must mount/sync a protected Git configuration workspace.
Skill refs are exact syntactically but Skill dependency/eval validation, immutable publication, materialization, and provenance are owned by NODE-31.
Hosted GitHub Actions were unable to allocate a runner on NODE-29 due to the account payment/spending-limit condition. NODE-30 must not claim hosted checks passed until a runner executes steps.
